texturemixer.button.mix.tooltip: Pick single textures from any installed pack, enabled or not, and combine them into one custom pack.
texturemixer.title: Texture Mixer
texturemixer.view.tooltip:
Pack textures: textures at least one pack changes.
My picks: only textures you picked a version for.
All textures: every texture, including ones no pack changes.
texturemixer.profile.tooltip: Switch, create, rename or delete texture profiles.
texturemixer.reset.tooltip: Clear every pick in this profile, so all textures go back to whatever your enabled packs show. Can be undone.
texturemixer.randomize.tooltip: Pick a random version for every texture currently listed. Can be undone.
texturemixer.export.tooltip: Save this profile as a normal .zip resource pack in .minecraft/texturemixer/exports.
texturemixer.export.done.title: Pack exported
texturemixer.export.done.message: Saved "%s" with %s texture(s). Open the exports folder?
texturemixer.apply.tooltip: Build "Texture Mixer - Custom Pack", enable it above your other packs and reload resources. Your other packs and their order are left as they are. (Ctrl+S)
texturemixer.panel.hint: Click a texture (or use the arrow keys) to see every version of it. Number keys 1-9 pick a version.
texturemixer.option.legacy: Old pre-1.13 name, not used here
texturemixer.empty.no_packs: No textures found. Put resource packs (folders or .zip files) in the resourcepacks folder; they do not need to be enabled.
texturemixer.empty.no_changes: You have not picked any textures in this profile yet.
texturemixer.status.reset: All picks cleared. Undo to bring them back.
texturemixer.status.randomized: Randomized %s texture(s). Undo to go back.
texturemixer.problems.title: Resource pack problems
texturemixer.profiles.title: Texture Profiles
texturemixer.profiles.name: Profile name
texturemixer.profiles.use.tooltip: Edit the selected profile. Press Apply afterwards to put its textures in game.
texturemixer.profiles.new.tooltip: Create an empty profile (named after the text box, if filled in).
texturemixer.profiles.rename.tooltip: Rename the selected profile to the text in the box.
texturemixer.profiles.delete.confirm.mes: "%s" and its texture picks will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
texturemixer.profiles.type_name: Type the new name in the box first.
texturemixer.bulk.reset: Set all %s listed back to unchanged
texturemixer.bulk.tooltip: Applies this texture's pick to every texture currently listed that has a version from the same pack. Narrow the list first with the tabs or the search box. Can be undone.
texturemixer.status.bulk_used: Picked %s for %s texture(s). Undo to go back.
texturemixer.status.bulk_reset: Set %s texture(s) back to unchanged. Undo to go back.
texturemixer.leave.title: Apply your picks?
texturemixer.leave.message: Some picks are not in game yet. They are saved either way; apply them now to see them?
texturemixer.status.packs_changed: Your resource packs changed; the list was updated.
